review:
The singing frog is back on BGaming's Trueways engine – no paylines, up to 262,144 ways. A new Lightning symbol splits reel blocks in two, adding even more ways mid-spin.

Pretty much every BGaming feature is in here: free spins, multiplier wilds and a Coin Respin with three jackpots. Chance x2 makes the features more likely. It's far swingier than the original Elvis Frog – very high volatility with a 5,000x max – and the RTP is a strong 96.7%. Free spins about once every 229 spins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
